newsitem.title: GERMANY: Four missing after blaze at German refugee centre. [CORRECTED 13:41 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Four missing after blaze at German refugee centre. [CORRECTED 13:41 GMT]

text.p: Four asylum-seekers were missing on Friday after fire swept through a refugee centre in the western German town of Monheim (corrects from Mettmann), police said.
Police said a man and his three children were missing after the fire which broke out mid-morning. Forty residents of the centre escaped unharmed.
Firefighters had brought the fire under control and were trying to enter the building, police said. The cause of the fire was not yet known.
In the past, refugee centres in Germany have been fire-bombed by far-right extremists. Most of these racist attacks occurred in the early morning after midnight.
